easyPrerequisites: You control at least four additional nontoken artifacts.
description:
If Dance of the Manse is in your graveyard, activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Dance of the Manse from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing it and sacrificing four other nontoken artifacts you control, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Dance of the Manse by paying {6}{W}{U}, returning Time Sieve, Codex Shredder and four other artifacts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.
